stem: What does harvest authorization allow a Technician I to do?
choices: Change destination and lot structure freely
Execute the defined task within the supplied scope; it does not grant independent release, disposal or process-redesign authority
rationale: Execute the defined task within the supplied scope; it does not grant independent release, disposal or process-redesign authority. This preserves the Course 006 safety, postharvest, traceability, contamination-control, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
